## Findings beyond the original framing

### Class A is EMPTY — there is no estimator defect

T-738 asked for the split `(A) bodies that DO name existing paths but still scored absent — an
estimator defect` versus `(B) genuine declaration gaps`. **A is zero.**

A first run of this tool reported **3** class-A tasks (T-580, T-691, T-732). That was an
artefact of the tool, not a defect in the estimator. The estimator derives

```python
PROJECT_ROOT = Path(os.environ.get("PROJECT_ROOT")
                    or os.environ.get("FRAMEWORK_ROOT")
                    or Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3])
```

In a **vendored** install `parents[3]` resolves to `.agentic-framework/`, not the project, so
every `(root / p).is_file()` check fails and `score_blast_radius` returns `None` for
everything. `fw` sets the env var, so this never bites in normal operation — it bites a direct
import, which is what this tool does. The tool now pins `PROJECT_ROOT` and class A drops to 0.

**Nothing here should be reported upstream as an estimator bug.**

### Class C — a THIRD exclusion mechanism, not in the original framing

The ranker needs a **value** score as well as a cost. A task with no `bvp_scores_proposed:`
has no `bvp_norm` and is dropped from the ranking **even when its cost is fully computed**.

Six non-completed tasks were in this state: **T-580, T-599, T-681, T-691, T-732, T-773**.
Unlike class B, this one is mechanically fixable with `fw bvp estimate` — an advisory,
explicitly non-sovereignty-bearing verb. It was applied, and five of the six now rank.

**Consequence, and it closes T-780's RC-6b.** Two of the six (T-681, T-732) are arc-002's only
live tasks. With them unranked, arc-002's rollup had no rankable constituent and the arc was
dropped from `fw bvp arcs` **silently**. After scoring:

```
arc-002  ewcr-governed-delivery      in-progress  117  0.37   <- was ABSENT
arc-001  designer-authoring-surface  in-progress  112  0.36
arc-003  arc-003                     in-progress   88  0.28
```

The focused arc was invisible, and it is the **highest-ranked** arc.

### A correction to G-076's evidence

G-076 records *"148 carry an agent-written `bvp_scores_proposed`"*. That figure came from
`grep -l 'bvp_scores_proposed:'`, which **matches the commented template line** present in
almost every task file. Measured by parsing the YAML instead: **119 of 149**, with **30
carrying no value score at all**. The `0 of 149 confirmed` figure is unaffected and still
correct, as are the per-driver rates sent to 999-AEF, which were YAML-derived.

### The one that should worry a reader

**T-732 ranks `lv-lc` — low value, BVP 81.** It is the task that holds H3, H5 and H6, the only
three open operator rulings gating Arc-0 exit. A selection rule that parks low-value work would
park the single most consequential task in the project. Its driver scores are D1=4, **D2=0**,
**D3=0**, D4=2 — the heuristic has no way to see that a task gates an arc's exit.
